summary.headline: H1 FY27 revenue rose 95% YoY to INR194.5 crores, with EBITDA margin up to 28.1% and PAT of INR36 crores (18.6% margin).
summary.overview: Yash Highvoltage reported H1 FY27 revenue from operations of INR194.5 crores, up 95% YoY, with volume up about 40% to roughly 4,000 bushings. Gross margin expanded to 48.3% from 42.4%, and EBITDA rose 139% to INR55 crores, lifting margin to 28.1% from 23.3%. Order book stood at INR760 crores as of 30 September 2026, against INR400 crores at the start of FY27, with execution over 15 to 18 months. Greenfield capex of INR220 crores is INR106 crores spent so far, with the balance over the next 12 months, and management reiterated the Brownfield expansion completing by Q3.

financial_highlights.metric: Retrofit and services share of domestic sales

segments.name: RIP bushings
segments.commentary: Contributed 86% of H1 FY27 revenue by value, while volume split was roughly 40% higher-voltage mix driven; H1 production close to 2,200 RIP units versus about 1,500 OIP units.

segments.name: OIP and high-current bushings
segments.commentary: Contributed 14% of H1 FY27 revenue by value; export order book is about INR40-50 crores, roughly 5-7% of the order book, mainly OIP for US customers.

segments.name: Retrofit and services (domestic)
segments.commentary: Grew to 8% of domestic sales from 4% a year earlier, per management.

guidance_outlook: Greenfield Jarod facility: ready up to 245 kV this year; localized 550 kV after 1 to 1.5 years. Commercial production of localized up-to-245 kV bushings expected from Q4 FY27; 420 kV and 550 kV from Q4 FY28 or mid-FY28.
Combined Unit 1 and Unit 2 invoicing potential of INR900-1,000 crores, with full utilisation expected by FY31.
Management said the existing order book should carry through 15-18 months (or 18-20 months), with new orders booked in the meantime.
Export RIP bushing orders expected from mid-next year (FY28), with the export mix changing from FY28-29.
Expects H2 revenue to be broadly balanced with H1 and says it is not targeting a sharp H2 skew; no FY27 revenue number given.
Expects PAT margin to be maintained despite depreciation of about 2.5 to 3 times last year's level, with most of the increase falling in H2.
Targets global market share of at least 5% in 4 to 5 years, from about 1-1.2% today.
capex_capacity: Greenfield capex of INR220 crores, of which INR106 crores spent until 30 September 2026; balance over next 12 months.
Brownfield expansion expected to complete by end of Q3 FY27, with capacity visible in Q4.
Halol existing unit running at about 90% capacity utilisation on three shifts; new facility using assembly and testing halls since September, with ramp-up in H2.
Localized core trial results described as very encouraging; bushings to be sent for type test in the next couple of weeks, with external lab validation pending.
Future capex expected to be funded from internal accruals; management said remaining investment is not expected to be substantial.
demand_pricing: Management said demand from India and abroad is rising, and that the market is a seller's market for the next 2 to 4 years, with bushings having reasonable entry barriers.
Some new entrants have announced bushing investments; management said it is prepared.
Bushing prices range from INR30,000-35,000 for a 72.5 kV OIP unit to INR36-44 lakh for a 420 kV unit.
Import cost, duty and freight currently about 18-20% of cost; localization expected to remove this, subject to customer pricing and competitor pricing.
US: representation agreements cover close to 27 states; agents in close to 30 countries; OIP export orders carry 6-15 month lead times.

qa_highlights.question: What drove EBITDA margin to 28% and is it sustainable into H2 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management credited product mix, sales and procurement improvements, factory efficiency and overhead absorption from higher volume; said the aim is to maintain or improve margins without giving a specific number.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins rise to 32-35% after core localization?
qa_highlights.answer: Keyur Shah declined to give a specific target, saying the company will see the impact of localized production before committing; earlier guidance was about 30%.

qa_highlights.question: Order book from exports and share of export orders?
qa_highlights.answer: Export order book is about INR40-50 crores, roughly 5-7% of the INR700-odd crore book at the time of the call.

qa_highlights.question: H1 production split between RIP and OIP?
qa_highlights.answer: Close to 1,500 OIP and close to 2,200 RIP bushings were produced in H1 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Revenue potential from expanded capacity and timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Combined Unit 1 and Unit 2 invoicing potential of INR900-1,000 crores, with full utilisation by 2030-31.

qa_highlights.question: Volume growth in H1 FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: About 4,000 bushings in H1 FY27 versus 2,950 in H1 FY26, around 40% growth; no product-wise split given.

qa_highlights.question: Receivable days and non-current assets rise?
qa_highlights.answer: Receivable days were 47 in H1 FY27 versus 45 for full FY26; the rise in other non-current assets to INR40 crores from INR11 crores reflects advances to international core vendors to secure slots.

risks_watch: Localized core type testing and approval (plant and product approval) expected in Q3 FY27; delay would postpone localized margin benefit.
Dependence on imported cores from international vendors; advances to vendors rose to INR40 crores.
Competition from new high-voltage bushing entrants and from Chinese component players, which management says is limited historically.
H2 revenue linearity: management aims for balanced H1 and H2, but past years saw H2 outperform.
Depreciation rising to about 2.5-3x last year; PAT margin target depends on maintaining profitability.
Management did not confirm FY27 revenue guidance; analyst-cited INR450-500 crore figure not endorsed.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, margins and execution, with clear optimism on localization and US expansion. Cautious and evasive on forward numbers: declined to give specific margin, FY27 revenue, and localized realization figures.
key_quotes: And honestly, sir, I would not want to make any tall commitments.

We have got reasonable idea, but not that much that I can make a commitment today.
